head: 9a334d122c4515c6d38f2d207fab3b9904a63f06
title: fix(workout): offline workouts reach the server exactly once with sets intact; coach sees them; resume after the app closes (WORKOUT-SYNC-124, T3)
body:
WORKOUT-SYNC-124 (agent 124, builder Claude Opus 5.5). T3 (offline data path + Finish flow). Mobile only, no backend change, no migration on the server.

**Base: main.** Originally stacked on #397 (merged); rebased onto main 321274f3 after #401 merged (one-hunk conflict in ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx: the posted body is the queued `workoutPayload`, which now carries #401's workout and exercise notes). #397 is unchanged.

## B (normal use)
| id | normal-day story | fix |
|---|---|---|
| B-WSYNC-1 | A client finishes a workout in a gym basement with no signal. The app keeps one row per exercise and later rebuilds a body with no `workout_name` / `workout_type` / `muscle_group` and an extra `local_id`; the server's strict validation answers 400, the engine dead-letters the row, and the workout never reaches the server or the coach. | Finish queues ONE row holding the exact POST /workouts body (`src/offline/sync/sync-engine.ts` `queueWorkout`), sent as-is by the sync engine. |
| B-WSYNC-2 | Same client: the screen says "Workout not saved yet ... tap Finish again". Tapping Finish again (still offline, or later online) writes a second copy; with the payload fixed that becomes a duplicate workout on the coach's view. | Queue key = user + session start (survives resume); a second Finish updates the same row; a row the screen is still saving is held from the background sync; a synced session is never sent again. |
| B-WSYNC-3 | A coach-assigned workout finished offline is never marked done for the coach: completion was only sent from the online success branch. | The assignment completion (same UUID idempotency key, started_at, full set detail) is stored with the queued workout and sent right after the workout lands; retried on the next sync if there was no answer. |
| B-WSYNC-4 | A client whose app was closed or killed mid-workout reopens the app and sees nothing about it; the saved sets are reachable only by starting some workout and answering "Resume?", and resuming from Quick Workout loses the routine name and the coach assignment. | Workouts tab "Workout in progress" card (name, time, sets logged) that reopens the same workout with its name, sets and assignment, without asking again. |

## U
- No signal at Finish now says "Saved on this phone. No connection right now. The workout will be sent to your coach automatically once the phone is back online." and closes the screen, instead of trapping the client on "not saved yet".
- Workouts tab notice while finished workouts are waiting to send; it clears itself when they land, and the tab refreshes.
- Queued workouts are also sent on every Workouts tab visit (a cold start online has no reconnect event) and the push reads the user id asynchronously when the synchronous cache is not hydrated yet.
- Double-tap Finish: #397's saving state blocks the second tap; the session key makes a repeat harmless anyway.

## C (edge, deferred to 10k clients)
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): POST reaches the server but the answer is lost (timeout after commit) -> a later retry can duplicate; needs a server idempotency key on POST /workouts.
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): signing out with a workout still queued deletes it (sign-out scrubs workout_logs for the user).
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): rows written by pre-launch builds (per-exercise, no payload) keep the old path.
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): wall-clock rollback during a session changes the queue key.

## Tests (each B fails on main)
- `src/__tests__/workoutSync124.engine.test.ts`: fake server applies CreateWorkoutDto whitelist rules; offline workout lands with all sets; old per-exercise row is refused (anchor); stays queued with no signal then goes out; assignment completed after the workout; exactly-once (re-Finish, held while the screen saves, synced never resent); refused body parked, not retried.
- `src/__tests__/workoutSync124.screen.test.tsx`: Finish with no signal queues the exact body, closes, says saved; success settles the queued copy; 400 parks and re-Finish reuses the same key; assigned workout queues its completion; Workouts tab card reopens with name + assignment + `resume`; resume param skips the prompt; waiting notice.
- Existing mocks: `syncEngine.test.ts` accepts `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX`; `romanP3FlagOffFinishWorkout.test.tsx` mocks the new offline exports.

No backend change. No secrets. Commit identity Bradley Gleave.
